messages:
Asha: quick flag  noticed a bunch of enterprise customers received onboarding emails this morning. someone flipped the new "auto-enroll trials" toggle in Playbook Admin and the cohort selector matched way too broadly. pausing the rule for now.
Nima: oh no. do we have a count of affected accounts? can you scoped sample?
Asha: ran a quick query to scope: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) AS affected, account_tier
FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_state = 'enrolled'
  AND enrolled_via = 'admin_auto_enroll_ui'
  AND enrolled_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY account_tier;
```
Result: 274 affected (mostly "enterprise"), 12 starter. sample ids: acct_00912, acct_21123, acct_30098.
playbook-bot: alert: playbook-runner: 2026-03-25T09:02:11Z - triggered 286 enroll actions by admin_auto_enroll_ui (rule: onboarding_auto_enroll).
Callie: root cause: the new cohort regex field accepted "trial" and we didn't require anchors. admin typed "trial" which matched substrings like "enterprise-trial-prod" and "partner-trial-2026". the UI should show sample matches before apply.
Devon: we should revert the change and add two protections: 1) require anchored regex or explicit selector (e.g., ^trial-), 2) a confirmation modal that lists up to 50 sample accounts and requires typing the word "CONFIRM" for cohorts > 100 accounts.
Nima: agree. also add a server-side whitelist: auto-enroll cannot target account_tier IN ('enterprise','business') unless the operator has org_admin permission. that prevents accidental broad matches.
Asha: immediate mitigation: 1) Sam (ops) please roll back the toggle and pause onboarding_auto_enroll rule (done) 2) run a backout job to remove onboarding_state for enterprise accounts that were mistakenly enrolled.
Devon: backout API snippet: 
```bash
# idempotent patch to clear accidental enrolls for enterprise accounts
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/accounts/bulk_patch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"filter":"enrolled_via=\'admin_auto_enroll_ui\' AND account_tier=\'enterprise\' AND enrolled_at > now() - interval \'6 hours\'","patch":{"onboarding_state":null,"enrolled_via":null}}'
```
Nima: will run a dry-run first with --dry_run flag to log changed rows. also we need to capture if any renewal dates were bumped by enroll actions so we don't impact renewal risk scoring.
Callie: UI fixes: show sample preview, require anchors or a toggle "interpret as regex" with explanation, and a hard cap confirm for >100 accounts. I'll add that to the admin UX PR.
playbook-bot: info: audit-log: admin_action by callie_admin (UI change) 2026-03-25T08:57:03Z - cohort selector: "trial" -> applied.
ops-oncall: adding to incident board just in case customers reply or CS tickets spike. set alert: increase in inbound replies from enterprise segment.
Asha: timeline & owners: rollback + pause (Sam) - done; dry-run backout (Nima) in next 30m; backout apply after dry-run (Nima) 1h; UI guard changes (Callie) PR today; server-side permission guard (Devon) by EOD. we'll also send a short comms note to affected account owners.
Nima: running dry-run now, will post counts and any edge cases.
Asha: thanks team. once backout is clean let's add a short admin-runbook entry: "auto-enroll: preview required, regex anchors, tier whitelist" and link to backout playbook.
